div.p: Everything to know before you land: opening hours, age, dress code and tickets. Still a question? Write to hello@exodiaclub.example.be.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between collapsed

div.p: Friday and Saturday, from 11PM to 6AM. Last entry at 4AM.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button collapsed gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between

div.p: Yes. EXODIA is 18+ only, and a valid photo ID is required at the door.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button collapsed gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between

div.p: Smart: trousers and a shirt for men, an elegant outfit for women. The door has the final word.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none collapsed justify-content-between
button.span: Can I buy tickets at the door?

div.p: Yes, for €5 more than online, unless the night is sold out. Buying ahead is the surest way in.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button collapsed gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between
button.span: How do I book a birthday, a table or a private event?

div.p: Send a request from the Birthdays, VIP Tables or Private Hire page. Our team answers by email within 24 hours, or 48 hours for private events.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button collapsed gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between

div.p: Chaussée de Namur 40, 1367 Ramillies. By train to Gembloux station, then by bus.

button.class: accordion-header accordion-button collapsed gap-2 bg-transparent h6-fs fw-bold text-decoration-none text-reset transition-none justify-content-between

div.p: Write to hello@exodiaclub.example.be with the date of your night and a short description. Found items are kept for 30 days.
